case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client context, problem statement, quantified $1.18M savings, and multiple category-level proof points are all documented – sufficient for a strong case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: APDerm dermatology network unlocks $1.18 million in annual savings and 6× ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm) had grown to 40 clinics across New England, but purchasing remained decentralized and opaque. Hundreds of suppliers, inconsistent pricing, and pandemic-driven inflation were pressuring margins just as private-equity owner Waud Capital demanded EBITDA lift. Lacking internal procurement bandwidth, APDerm needed a partner to quickly consolidate spend, secure better pricing, and protect clinical operations.
approach_summary: Aggregated 12 months of AP data from 40 clinics, cleansed 3,000+ vendor records, and built a $6.3M Phase-1 spend baseline across seven high-value indirect categories.
Executed competitive RFPs in Medical Supplies, Courier, Janitorial, Telecom, and other areas, leveraging Treya’s category benchmarks to drive aggressive bids.
Optimized healthcare GPO tiers and transitioned 95% of clinical SKUs to a McKesson/HPG platform, delivering a 27% cut on $1.8M of medical supplies.
Renegotiated incumbent contracts—including lowering AthenaHealth billing fees from 1.80% to 1.50% of collections—while preserving preferred suppliers in 70% of categories.
Delivered quick wins such as UPS small-parcel rates within 45 days and established standardized pricing files and contract terms across all locations.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya generated $1,179,965 in verified annual run-rate savings—27% above the high-end pre-engagement estimate and more than triple the guaranteed minimum. With a fixed fee of $190K, APDerm realized a 6.2× return on consulting investment. Beyond the dollars, the project standardized pricing across 30+ locations, reduced supplier count, and gave leadership its first enterprise-wide spend visibility.
where_we_were_unique: Captured first live savings within 45 days via UPS small-parcel program
Deep healthcare sourcing and GPO expertise secured Tier-1 pricing unavailable to most mid-sized practices
Hands-on data cleansing turned fragmented AP files into an actionable baseline, enabling fact-based negotiations
Collaborative, clinician-friendly change management retained incumbents in critical categories, minimizing operational disruption while still exceeding savings targets

generation_notes: ROI calculated as $1.18M savings / $0.19M fee = 6.2×, rounded to 6× for headline.
Savings exceeded original Exhibit A high estimate ($0.93M) by ~27%; this fact used in value blurb.
Top levers ranked by contribution: Medical Supplies (GPO), Billing Services (renegotiation), Janitorial & Courier (RFP/consolidation), Telecom right-sizing.
